title_zh: 从东方红一号到空间站
title_en: Chinese History (20/20): From Dongfanghong-1 to the Space Station
note_en: 从…到…，再到… lists stages of a development in order: 从第一颗人造卫星到载人航天，再到建设空间站 "from the first satellite to crewed spaceflight, and then on to building a space station." 再 ("then, next") before the last 到 marks it as the following step, much like English "and then on to." The text closes by echoing the same frame: 从第一颗人造卫星到今天的空间站.
